web.named_query: ("Donald Trump" OR "JD Vance") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: On July 23, 2025, Trump described American AI as contributing to a national future of greater prosperity, strength, and freedom. On June 2, 2026, he stated that advanced AI strengthens the nation while introducing security considerations requiring coordinated government action. On September 29, 2026, he expressed confidence that AI would be beneficial and that industry self-policing could keep it safe.
